name: airlock
description: Boundary attestation primitive. Proves what crossed the model boundary, which upstream artifacts influenced it, and what claim level was earned. `assemble` builds a deterministic prompt payload plus prompt provenance, `verify` checks a model request against the policy and emits an airlock manifest, `explain` summarizes a manifest, and `witness` queries the local receipt ledger. `doctor`, `capabilities` and `robot-docs` are read-only discovery surfaces.

options.name: describe
options.description: Print this operator manifest (identical to `capabilities --json`) and exit 0

options.name: schema
options.description: Print the airlock manifest JSON Schema and exit 0

commands.name: assemble
commands.description: Assemble a deterministic prompt payload plus prompt provenance from policy-approved inputs.

options.name: input
options.description: Input JSON artifact; repeat for multiple upstream artifacts

options.name: system_prompt
options.description: Optional UTF-8 system prompt file included in provenance

options.name: boundary_mode
options.description: Boundary exposure mode: ANNOTATED (default) or TELEMETRY_ONLY

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify a request boundary against the policy and emit an airlock manifest, including for BOUNDARY_FAILED.

options.name: policy
options.description: Boundary policy YAML used during assembly

options.name: require_claim
options.description: Minimum acceptable claim: BOUNDARY_FAILED, RAW_DOCUMENT_ABSENT or STRICT_TELEMETRY_ONLY

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Render a human-readable or machine-readable explanation of an airlock manifest without re-verifying it.

commands.name: witness
commands.description: Query the local witness ledger (`query`, `last`, `count`) without recording witness entries. `query`, `last` and `count` currently exit 1 when no records match.

commands.name: capabilities
commands.description: Emit this machine-readable contract (same document as --describe).

commands.name: robot-docs
commands.description: Print the compact agent-facing guide (`robot-docs guide`).

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Inspect read-only CLI health without reading run artifacts or touching witness state; every JSON form is a cmdrvl.doctor.v1 report. `doctor --json` is mode health; `doctor capabilities --json` is mode capabilities (its `contract` is this document); `doctor triage --json` is mode triage (with next_actions). Exits 0 healthy, 1 unhealthy. Deprecated aliases kept for compatibility: `doctor health [--json]`, `doctor --robot-triage` and top-level `--robot-triage` (same document as `doctor triage --json`).

0.meaning: VERIFY_PASS: the command completed and any --require-claim was met; also a healthy doctor and every read-only discovery surface (a verify that earns BOUNDARY_FAILED without --require-claim still exits 0 with an honest manifest verdict)

1.meaning: VERIFY_PARTIAL: verification completed but the achieved claim fell below --require-claim; also `doctor` reporting an unhealthy state (an error finding); also `witness query|last|count` when no records match

2.meaning: REFUSAL or CLI/usage error: a structured refusal envelope on stdout (bad policy, input, prompt, request, provenance or manifest, missing file, witness or internal error), or a clap usage error

refusals.message: Boundary policy failed to parse or validate
An input artifact or argument is malformed or unusable
prompt_payload.json is malformed or not a prompt airlock assembled
The transport-wrapped model request is malformed or unsupported
prompt_provenance.json is malformed or inconsistent with the prompt

refusals.action: Re-run `airlock verify` to regenerate the manifest

refusals.message: A required file does not exist
The witness ledger could not be read or queried
refusals.action: Check EPISTEMIC_WITNESS and the ledger path, or use `--no-witness`
Report this with the refusal detail

env_vars.name: NO_COLOR
env_vars.description: Disable ANSI color in human output (airlock emits none when piped)

env_vars.name: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH
env_vars.description: Fixed Unix timestamp used instead of the wall clock for reproducible output

env_vars.name: TERM
env_vars.description: TERM=dumb disables ANSI color in human output

side_effects.notes: assemble and verify write the paths given by --out/--provenance-out and append one witness record unless --no-witness is set; explain, witness, doctor, capabilities and robot-docs are read-only and never open or create the witness ledger for writing.
